items.title: Nepal sets up round-the-clock centre to combat online financial scams
items.blurb: Police, banks, payment firms and telecom operators will work under one roof to trace stolen funds, freeze accounts and disable the digital infrastructure used by fraudsters.

items.title: Reconstruction aid, strategic ties, pending disputes on PM’s India visit agenda
items.blurb: Prime Minister Balendra Shah’s proposed four-day visit starting November 22 comes at a critical juncture in Nepal-India relations. Kathmandu is seeking billions in aid for post-flood recovery, air connectivity, and…

items.title: ‘Panch Pandav’ to hit theatres amid boycott calls and threats
items.blurb: The Communications Ministry says the film should be allowed to screen, as its makers raise concerns over threats to vandalise a cinema hall in Nepalgunj.

items.title: Why the NPL can turn Nepal’s promises into wins
items.blurb: Close losses to South Africa and England show what is missing. The league, and a home qualifier in December, offer a chance to fix it.

items.title: Nearly 10 million Nepali children exposed to unhealthy air, UNICEF warns
items.blurb: Millions more face drought, extreme heat and landslides, with overlapping climate and environmental hazards threatening children's health, education and protection, a new report says.

items.title: India secures 4,700MW in Nepal, but little progress on projects
items.blurb: Despite deals for seven major hydropower projects, only one is under construction, raising questions about Nepal’s export ambitions and the benefits of its power agreements with India.
